programme.title: Greenwashing
programme.desc: It's a term that's come to the fore in recent years, as the urgency of the climate crisis becomes increasingly apparent "Greenwashing" is a troubling phenomenon in which companies which brand themselves as 'sustainable' - in hopes of attracting green investment - continue to cause massive pollution For the corporations responsible for a vast proportion of global emissions, just what lies behind the promises of climate action?

programme.title: Waging Change
programme.desc: From no paid sick leave, to a reliance on tips in order to make a living, the COVID-19 pandemic has revealed the many fault lines in the American restaurant industry that affect both workers and consumers As millions of restaurant workers were laid off in the face of the pandemic, Waging Change provides a behind the scenes look at what needs to change so that restaurant workers can receive a living wage once restaurants re-open Featuring Saru Jayaraman, Lily Tomlin, Jane Fonda and Rep Alexandria Ocasio Cortez, the film reveals two American workers’ struggles hidden in plain sight-- the effort to end the federal tipped minimum wage of $213 for restaurant servers and bartenders and the #MeToo movement's efforts to end sexual harassment

programme.title: Ocean to Sky
programme.desc: In 1953, Edmund Hillary and Tenzing Norgay were the first to summit Mount Everest That same year, the jetboat was invented With this new invention, Hillary strove to also become the first to tackle the Himalayas' greatest river: the Ganges It was a perilous journey from ocean to sky, achieved while also battling grief, following the death of Hillary's wife and youngest daughter A story of surmounting the insurmountable - both physically and mentally

Later in the program, he meets the president of Canada's Freethought Association, which stirs up a little controversy with it's provocative ad slogan "There's probably no God So stop worrying and enjoy life" Finally, he finds himself immersed in God

programme.title: Cosmic

programme.title: DIY Country
programme.desc: In Spring 2014, armed pro-Russian rebels stormed the city of Donetsk in eastern Ukraine After seizing control of the city, the separatists held a referendum - labelled illegal by the US and EU - and independence from Kiev was declared This brave documentary explores the origins and evolution of the Donetsk People's Republic, diving into hopeful beginnings and eventual descent into enduring conflict

programme.title: Dances with the Wind
programme.desc: ‘Fury Dance’ is a story about a Korean protest dancer, Sam-hun Lee He fought for the democratization of South Korea in the ‘80’s through dance, while giving up his own dream to become a ballerino The film takes the viewer through prominent events in South Korean history, as Sam-hun dances to soothe the souls of victims who were killed by the Korean national violence during the past 30 years During the 1980 Gwangju Massacre however, Sam-hun developed a panic disorder So he crosses through the Eurasian rail with difficulty when invited to attend a festival to dance in France Through his journey, he attempts to overcome his claustrophobic fears in France, revisits his lost dream of becoming a ballerino in Russia, and dances for the Holocaust victims in Poland Documented for 15 years, this film is dedicated to those who lost their noble lives while fighting for freedom against the unjust political power

programme.title: Shockwave
programme.desc: On a hot August evening in the Lebanese capital of Beirut, a catastrophic explosion ripped through the city It looked like a scene from a disaster movie, but it was real As the shocking event unfolded, people around the city captured the moment, and its aftermath, on their phones These videos soon went viral This documentary tells the stories of many of those who filmed the blast as well as survivors whose experiences in the moment were dramatically captured onscreen From a bride posing for her wedding photos when the explosion erupted, to divers at sea struck by the blast wave, to the young doctor tending to a woman in labour as the windows exploded inwards, each has an extraordinary story of survival

programme.title: 如果還有明天4 能回家真好

programme.title: 一生最美的祝福音樂巡迴佈道會
programme.desc: 由「愛基金」主辦、「創世電視」協辦的「一生最美的祝福音樂巡迴佈道會」,聯合不同教會的力量,加上演藝人的見證,將福音帶給香港市民。

programme.title: 屬靈教室: 陳一華牧師 - 從聖經看敬祖與祭祖之行動

programme.title: 屬靈教室: 關越山牧師- 聖經中的祈禱勇士
programme.desc: 衛道神學研究院的關越山博士,是屬靈成長科副教授,專研禱告和關顧事工,在節目中他會透過亞伯拉罕、撒母耳、耶穌和保羅,結合現代宣教士的例子,具體指出如何培養恆常禱告的習慣,成為出色的祈禱勇士!

programme.title: 喜樂婆婆會客室

programme.desc: 有人說,人生是一場戲,在人生的過程中,尋找有時、碰壁有時、迷失有時、覺醒有時,說真的,這些起承轉合比真正的電影情節更精彩,每一個「你」,都是天父特別設計的人生劇本主角。 今天,我們的世界充滿了末世風情,醉生夢死、迷失自我了結生命的悲劇每天上演,創世電視藉100個見證故事挽救生命,100位來自世界各地

programme.title: 如果還有明天4 能回家真好
programme.desc: 每一個人,都需要一個溫暖、安全,可以得到庇護的家。可是,能回家的路不是必然,可以與摯愛天家相聚也並非絕對,突如起來的天災,毫無先兆的頑疾,極速致命的意外,誤入歧途的決定,足以令一個家毀於一旦。n第四輯《如果還有明天》搜羅多個見證故事,有50年代經典歌曲《情人的眼淚》原唱者潘秀瓊、《陰陽路》編劇、狗仔

programme.title: 福氣教會講道系列
programme.desc: 如何建立健康強盛的教會? 改變社群可以轉化城市? 作為基督徒,我們又如何盡忠地完成普世宣教使命? 一個「幸福小組」,讓教會續步履行三個使命!由台灣高雄福氣教會牧者主講,從《聖經》的話語開始,一起來學習「幸福」智慧!

高朋滿座#199粵
programme.desc: 亨請眾品嚐「白松露菌宴」，條件是出席者均要是夫婦或戀人。義和花欲將戀情曝光，三妗婆突到高家，更指責喜因要出席「露菌宴」而不陪她看大戲。三更強拉花與根回家，翌日更到藥房代根辭職，並要子女與高家斷絕關係。

programme.title: 玉樓春#13粵普
programme.desc: 少春拿出全副身家辦義舍賑濟災民。與孫遜不和的梁京冠舉薦玉樓去南方賑災。映雪偷看孫遜的奏疏，將內容洩露給賈逢源，被賈逢源利用，迫使孫遜舉薦自己做御史。少春知小雅對琅琊王氏嫡子王均心生愛慕，費心撮合二人。

programme.title: 方德證券獨家呈現:交易現場粵 及 潮流生活誌之綻放 · 鼎級笑容粵
今個夏天食平D粵
programme.desc: 甚麼菜蔬連同芝士剁碎後香炸，做出得意小食不怕小朋友偏食？運用香芋冬瓜煲出的湯水，芋香味冬瓜口感夠玩味！肥媽加入椰漿炒素菜，製造泰式風味素菜。肥媽到觀眾家中煮菜，讓觀眾學懂令餸菜變精采的變通之法！

programme.title: 賽馬會智啟潛能學習計劃呈獻：「特」適其適粵
語你同行三十載粵
programme.desc: 「深耕三十載 ，語你譜新篇」，教育局、語文教育及研究常務委員會(語常會)三十年來，致力協助在香港推動兩文三語。節目由星級藝員梁凱晴(Carina)、焦浩軒、語常會學生語文大使Anisah Hussain擔綱演出，述說當局如何透過政策藍圖、撥款、教學支援、多元化活動等各方面，讓本港市民，尤其是中小學生提升語文水平，進一步掌握兩文三語的運用。

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 嘉賓莊紹嘉當年不幸遭狗隻襲擊，導致左眼永久受損。作為過來人，他呼籲狗主務必看管好自家毛孩，並細說自己如何走出創傷陰霾。紹嘉縱成視障人士，仍積極投身公益服務，他坦言希望將愛心傳承下一代。藝人羅敏莊一家三口移居泰國近五年，享受「Chill」慢生活節奏。夫妻感情要保鮮，敏莊大讚老公陳國邦每天做甜蜜舉動，令她心動。敏莊還大方透露二人有協議，若有朝感情生變會坦然面對。「睇餸食飯」，陳國賓示範「人參腐皮卷」。

programme.title: 不老傳說粵
programme.desc: 劉天蘭從藝人轉型為著名形象顧問，堪稱才女。天蘭不論跟殿堂級歌手或是新演員，同樣能做到合作無間。她本著一顆好奇心融入不同領域，皆因深信「眼界決定境界」。天蘭喜歡與女兒結伴出遊，同時卻要求女兒獨立自處，對育兒有何獨到心得？回歸健康生活「有心唔怕遲」！天蘭多年前決心戒煙，及後積極投入運動鍛練體魄、節制飲食，作為送給自己的生日禮物，努力成果亦伴隨而至。「菁峰生活」，梓峰帶大家感受訊號山公園的清幽舒適環境。

programme.title: 老表，你好hea！#3粵PG
programme.desc: 利亞找到林雪作為吃軟飯目標。林雪到電視台投考多項比賽，卻未能入選。尤田於超市舉行美食節，迫員工穿上厚厚的毛裘服飾。在野偶遇靜雯，認出她是中學同學，靜雯母親秋水來到，責靜雯男友郭寶沒好好保護靜雯。

programme.title: 方德證券獨家呈現:交易現場粵
櫻桃小丸子粵日
programme.desc: 小丸子在繪畫比賽獲獎，在全校集會上獲頒獎狀，卻在等候上台時人有三急，令她不知如何是好。小丸子一家人去吃法國菜，由於價錢超乎預期，爸爸身上帶不夠錢，幸好小丸子帶了紅包錢來以防萬一。

programme.title: Hands Up粵
programme.desc: 新環節「粵劇READY GO」，會以趣味方式讓小朋友體驗粵劇文化。正印花旦謝曉瑩帶來「馬鞭」道具，教廠內小朋友學習上馬、騎馬、勒馬、打馬等基本動作，再試演一幕《虎牢關前配戰馬》，小朋友都做到活學活用。大多小朋友都愛吃快餐店的薯條、漢堡包，家長卻擔心會影響健康，不妨以紙筆畫出一份套餐，或可同時滿足雙方。薯條要注意甚麼細節，才可畫得更有光澤？漢堡包的材料任由繪畫者選擇，喜愛的話更可不停加材料和層數呢！

programme.title: 多啦A夢粵
programme.desc: 大雄想用「報社遊戲套裝」效法小夫出版報紙，卻被小夫斷章取義式報導陷害而聲名狼藉。大雄擅自拿走後備百寶袋，亂用法寶找靜香和嚮明星討簽名，還把大堆垃圾塞進百寶袋，最後被多啦A夢追究。

programme.title: 財經新聞粵

programme.desc: 盧漢娜發現蛛絲馬跡，懷疑在「開心小棧」任職店員的男友鐵金剛與住客朱圓圓似有不妥，於是到「開心小棧」瞭解情況，始知金剛因圓圓而苦不堪言。漢娜不忍金剛受折磨，勸他拒絕圓圓的無理要求，惟金剛始終做不到。漢娜決意為金剛出頭，向楊光打聽圓圓如何折磨嘉驄，並設法向圓圓還以顏色。漢娜故意支開金剛，假意代其為圓圓效勞，令圓圓吃盡苦頭之餘，更想到一條妙計，有望令圓圓不再勞役金剛……

programme.title: 死有對証#22粵PG

programme.title: 高朋滿座#200粵

programme.title: 流行都市粵

老婆大人#3粵
programme.desc: 亞基向通叔訛稱國光有外遇激怒希敏，才令其三代同堂夢碎。國光被希敏趕出家門，幸彥祖大哭救了他。智雄接手天娜和志誠案，指亞基訂定的婚前協議書無效，但天娜偷竊罪也不成立。昕昕同情撿垃圾被檢控的婆婆，被希敏責罵感情用事不適合當主控官，委屈落淚。希敏細訴自已立志當法官往事，讓昕昕明白其苦心。通叔逼國光跟情婦劃清界線，亞基只好訛稱昕昕是情婦；通叔贈金項給昕昕作分手費。昕昕以為通叔要賄賂她，致電希敏及廉正公署。

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 心絞痛揭示心臟健康問題，不但形容胸口出現的「痛」，也可表現為「悶」或「壓著」，其常見原因是冠狀動脈血管收窄或閉塞。心臟科醫生提醒，痛楚或會擴散至身體不同部位，不容忽視。腎科專科醫生指腎功能開始下降時，通常並無明顯症狀，如持續有蛋白尿就是腎臟受損的早期警號！檢查腎病有何指標？醫生細述慢性腎病的高危因素，糖尿病正是其一，而腎病亦有可能影響心血管健康？「睇餸食飯」，李安生示範「薑蓉蔥油帶子蟹肉意粉」。

programme.title: 不老傳說粵
programme.desc: 盧敏儀個性天真活潑，由電視節目主持搖身變為執業大律師，形象與身分縱然大有不同，唯獨一顆赤子之心始終不變。當年敏儀曾為大型節目作高難度表演，精彩場面令人難忘。事隔多年，她依然身手矯健，箇中有何秘訣？她並即席展示日子有功的鍛練絕活。敏儀享受工作，並將事務所視為另一個家。不過，律師終日面對工作壓力，敏儀幸有丈夫相伴驅除煩惱，二人細說恩愛如昔的心得。另外，梓峰、芷菁同往動植物公園，跟可愛動物共享寫意時光。

programme.title: 老表，你好hea！#5粵PG
programme.desc: 牧師馬拉高出現於優富超市，利亞以為龍豹向拉高洩露了他的行蹤。拉高救炳哥一命而廉價租下拳館開教會。秋水得悉女性生育後或有助醫治敏感症，便著手籌備郭寶與靜雯的婚禮。靜雯被逼與郭寶親吻，卻因此當眾出醜……

programme.title: 高朋滿座#201粵
programme.desc: 亨與麗拍拖後愛上到處享受人生，又發現養育下一代需花費巨額金錢。亨一心想賺多些錢，為與麗的未來作出準備，更欲為瑜珈中心開設分店。本來，麗對亨的舉動也心存讚賞，但亨因過分投入搵錢大計而冷落麗。

programme.title: 玉樓春#15粵普PG
programme.desc: 玉樓被強盜綁架，少春隻身赴會贖人，用巧計救出玉樓。玉樓求得皇上賜婚。孫遜私下約見少春，被她的言行打動，不再反對婚事。賈逢源模仿孫遜字跡偽造書信，告訴少春是孫遜害死其父。大婚日孫遜喝下少春敬的茶後昏迷。

programme.title: Sunday好戲王粵PG
programme.desc: 「阿姐」汪明荃華麗駕臨，擔任「星級」評判，就著嘉賓藝員唐詩詠、沈震軒、何遠東、楊秀惠的「鬥戲」發揮，評選各個回合的贏家。究竟四位「好戲王」怎樣互拼演技兼發放「笑彈」？

programme.title: 優雅的朋友們
programme.desc: 【夫婦的世界「升級版」！初戀女神現身揭開五人幫隱藏面具】一場離奇猝死與密室謀殺，撕裂大學「五人幫」維持二十年的體面假象。死黨萬植離世，失蹤多年的初戀海淑突然現身，喚醒男人們被西裝掩蓋的慾望與罪惡。模範人夫宮哲察覺妻子靜海疑似出軌，威脅她的教練卻隨即身亡，監視器與證物一夜消失。嫉妒的丈夫、被逼到絕境的妻子、病態迷戀的死黨，誰在說謊？當秘密層層揭開，每個人都是嫌疑犯，誰才是最終的殺人兇手？

programme.title: 被告人
programme.desc: 【話題冠軍韓劇，正義檢察官池晟孤軍奮戰尋找真兇！！】最強正義檢察官樸政宇，被冤枉殺害妻女入獄及事件發生後失去了記憶，成為了被告人。為了洗刷背負的嫌疑罪名而不得不在獄中拼湊記憶與找出殺害妻女的真兇，這時他也進入人生最糟糕的兩難選擇，陷入檢察官的鬥爭中。

programme.title: 裸婚時代
programme.desc: 【八年愛情遇上現實婚後生活秒變修羅場】劉易陽與童佳倩相戀八年，決定在懷孕之際不顧家境懸殊與雙方父母的強烈反對，選擇沒房、沒車、沒鑽戒、沒婚禮的「裸婚」。兩人原以為愛情足以抵擋現實，但婚後卻發現，與易陽父母同住的壓力、兩家價值觀的衝突，以及柴米油鹽的重擔正逐步侵蝕他們的浪漫。當理想被生活逼到牆角，這對一路走來的戀人，究竟能否守住最初的承諾，為愛打下一個真正的家？

programme.title: 兩個女人的房間
programme.desc: 【慘遭閨蜜心機暗算朴恩惠由飯店繼承人淪為女僕】在瑞士留學歸來後，晴彩充滿自信地踏入了蒙娜麗莎飯店，端莊秀麗的外表和聰穎的頭腦，讓她很快成為了飯店的副社長兼繼承人。與同飯店的總經理志燮之間的戀情，更是讓她的生活充滿了甜蜜和期待。一場車禍意外將掀起腥風血雨，當晴彩以為自己撞死了熙秀的養父時，內心充滿了恐懼與內疚感，在晴彩的堅持下，熙秀搬進了她的家，開始了新的生活。從那時起，晴彩心愛的人和她的一切都逐漸被熙秀所奪走，包括飯店的地位和財富，晴彩更是從繼承人淪為女僕，為了奪回曾經的一切，晴彩將對熙秀展開復仇。

programme.title: 魔女之城
programme.desc: 【婆媳小姑撕破臉！命運抓弄下的同居奇蹟】一場毀滅性的家庭變故，讓原本關係緊繃的離婚婆婆、媳婦與小姑，命運交織地被迫同住在一個屋簷下。撕下以往的對立標籤，三個性格迥異、傷痕累累的女人在滿是摩擦與衝突的日常中，漸漸看清彼此的脆弱。她們相互扶持、攜手抵禦人生的逆境風浪，最終走出陰霾，共築出比血緣更堅固的暖心情誼！

programme.title: 奔跑吧薔薇
programme.desc: 【紈褲子弟情留落難千金，尋覓守護愛情的甜蜜配方】過著豐食無缺沒有大小姐架子的薔薇。一場家中巨變，面臨相親結婚丈夫的背叛，經濟困境及失去原生家庭的後盾。困境中憑著對料理的熱情及新生活，與食品公司會長的孫子相戀，奔向對方的路上還會遇上什麼樣的考驗?

programme.title: 當你沉睡時
programme.desc: 擁有預知夢能力的洪珠，因總是隻能夢見未來卻無力改變而讓她痛苦。不是金湯匙出生也沒有優秀的學歷及人脈，卻總是富有充滿正義感的檢察官宰璨。兩人的相遇為了阻止夢境的可怕事件變成現實，開始相信對方是否能成為扭轉未來的人呢?

programme.title: 極速悖論
programme.desc: 【超越速度的愛情故事，不只想見柯佳嬿，合作《覆流年》翟子路，賽車場上大談13歲差姊弟戀！！】從小將賽車作為夢想的陳墨白，最大目標就是登上超級方程式賽場。碰上了貴為空氣動力學工程師的沈溪，卻隱身為辦公室的打雜小妹。彼此成為重要的陪伴，賽車場上超越速度也突破兩人心魔，共同為了夢想努力。

programme.desc: 本劇改編自藍艾草的同名小說，許清嘉自幼父母雙亡，寒門苦讀成榜眼，與世交胡家的小女胡嬌喜結連理。胡嬌雖然出身屠戶家，不通文墨，但性格開朗積極、不拘小節，將一切打理得井井有條。

programme.title: 奔跑吧薔薇
programme.desc: 【紈褲子弟情留落難千金，尋覓守護愛情的甜蜜配方】過著豐食無缺沒有大小姐架子的薔薇。一場家中巨變，面臨相親結婚丈夫的背叛，經濟困境及失去原生家庭的後盾。困境中憑著對料理的熱情及新生活，與食品公司會長的孫子相戀，奔向對方的路上還會遇上什麼樣的考驗?

programme.title: 玉面桃花總相逢
programme.desc: 本劇改編自藍艾草的同名小說，許清嘉自幼父母雙亡，寒門苦讀成榜眼，與世交胡家的小女胡嬌喜結連理。胡嬌雖然出身屠戶家，不通文墨，但性格開朗積極、不拘小節，將一切打理得井井有條。

programme.desc: 【夫婦的世界「升級版」！初戀女神現身揭開五人幫隱藏面具】一場離奇猝死與密室謀殺，撕裂大學「五人幫」維持二十年的體面假象。死黨萬植離世，失蹤多年的初戀海淑突然現身，喚醒男人們被西裝掩蓋的慾望與罪惡。模範人夫宮哲察覺妻子靜海疑似出軌，威脅她的教練卻隨即身亡，監視器與證物一夜消失。嫉妒的丈夫、被逼到絕境的妻子、病態迷戀的死黨，誰在說謊？當秘密層層揭開，每個人都是嫌疑犯，誰才是最終的殺人兇手？

programme.title: 被告人
programme.desc: 【話題冠軍韓劇，正義檢察官池晟孤軍奮戰尋找真兇！！】最強正義檢察官樸政宇，被冤枉殺害妻女入獄及事件發生後失去了記憶，成為了被告人。為了洗刷背負的嫌疑罪名而不得不在獄中拼湊記憶與找出殺害妻女的真兇，這時他也進入人生最糟糕的兩難選擇，陷入檢察官的鬥爭中。

programme.title: 裸婚時代
programme.desc: 【八年愛情遇上現實婚後生活秒變修羅場】劉易陽與童佳倩相戀八年，決定在懷孕之際不顧家境懸殊與雙方父母的強烈反對，選擇沒房、沒車、沒鑽戒、沒婚禮的「裸婚」。兩人原以為愛情足以抵擋現實，但婚後卻發現，與易陽父母同住的壓力、兩家價值觀的衝突，以及柴米油鹽的重擔正逐步侵蝕他們的浪漫。當理想被生活逼到牆角，這對一路走來的戀人，究竟能否守住最初的承諾，為愛打下一個真正的家？

programme.title: 兩個女人的房間
programme.desc: 【慘遭閨蜜心機暗算朴恩惠由飯店繼承人淪為女僕】在瑞士留學歸來後，晴彩充滿自信地踏入了蒙娜麗莎飯店，端莊秀麗的外表和聰穎的頭腦，讓她很快成為了飯店的副社長兼繼承人。與同飯店的總經理志燮之間的戀情，更是讓她的生活充滿了甜蜜和期待。一場車禍意外將掀起腥風血雨，當晴彩以為自己撞死了熙秀的養父時，內心充滿了恐懼與內疚感，在晴彩的堅持下，熙秀搬進了她的家，開始了新的生活。從那時起，晴彩心愛的人和她的一切都逐漸被熙秀所奪走，包括飯店的地位和財富，晴彩更是從繼承人淪為女僕，為了奪回曾經的一切，晴彩將對熙秀展開復仇。

programme.title: 魔女之城
programme.desc: 【婆媳小姑撕破臉！命運抓弄下的同居奇蹟】一場毀滅性的家庭變故，讓原本關係緊繃的離婚婆婆、媳婦與小姑，命運交織地被迫同住在一個屋簷下。撕下以往的對立標籤，三個性格迥異、傷痕累累的女人在滿是摩擦與衝突的日常中，漸漸看清彼此的脆弱。她們相互扶持、攜手抵禦人生的逆境風浪，最終走出陰霾，共築出比血緣更堅固的暖心情誼！

programme.title: 奔跑吧薔薇
programme.desc: 【紈褲子弟情留落難千金，尋覓守護愛情的甜蜜配方】過著豐食無缺沒有大小姐架子的薔薇。一場家中巨變，面臨相親結婚丈夫的背叛，經濟困境及失去原生家庭的後盾。困境中憑著對料理的熱情及新生活，與食品公司會長的孫子相戀，奔向對方的路上還會遇上什麼樣的考驗?

programme.title: 當你沉睡時
programme.desc: 擁有預知夢能力的洪珠，因總是隻能夢見未來卻無力改變而讓她痛苦。不是金湯匙出生也沒有優秀的學歷及人脈，卻總是富有充滿正義感的檢察官宰璨。兩人的相遇為了阻止夢境的可怕事件變成現實，開始相信對方是否能成為扭轉未來的人呢?

programme.title: 極速悖論
programme.desc: 【超越速度的愛情故事，不只想見柯佳嬿，合作《覆流年》翟子路，賽車場上大談13歲差姊弟戀！！】從小將賽車作為夢想的陳墨白，最大目標就是登上超級方程式賽場。碰上了貴為空氣動力學工程師的沈溪，卻隱身為辦公室的打雜小妹。彼此成為重要的陪伴，賽車場上超越速度也突破兩人心魔，共同為了夢想努力。

programme.desc: 本劇改編自藍艾草的同名小說，許清嘉自幼父母雙亡，寒門苦讀成榜眼，與世交胡家的小女胡嬌喜結連理。胡嬌雖然出身屠戶家，不通文墨，但性格開朗積極、不拘小節，將一切打理得井井有條。

programme.desc: Kent’s extreme attempts to cure his toe fungus in time for a pool party cause the fungus to mutate and grow into a fungus-based replica of Kent himself. When Kent manages to contact aliens, they land at the Edison complex and demand that the Secret Lab kids help them find a very valuable "treasure" that their planet needs. programme.desc: Jeanne, a brilliant architect, is appointed to restore the sumptuous Daguerre mansion owned by an eccentric family. When the patriarch is found dead during a murder party, Jeanne finds herself caught up in a real-life investigation to unmask the killer.

programme.desc: Karin's world crumbles on her 40th anniversary when she discovers her husband’s infidelity. Seeking solace in a cooking class with renowned chef Henrik, she rediscovers her lifelong passions and learns that it is never too late to follow her dreams.

programme.title: Tuesday Club
programme.desc: Karin's world crumbles on her 40th anniversary when she discovers her husband’s infidelity. Seeking solace in a cooking class with renowned chef Henrik, she rediscovers her lifelong passions and learns that it is never too late to follow her dreams.

programme.title: Our River...Our Sky
programme.desc: Baghdad. Sara, a single mother and novelist, shocked into silence by the surrounding violence, has been unable to write. She and her neighbours struggle to resist the fragmentation of their world and renew a fragile sense of hope for a better future.

programme.title: A Far Shore
programme.desc: Seventeen-year-old Aoi is an underage mother struggling to make ends meet and dealing with her husband’s violent temper. After her husband loses his job, their continuous fights lead them to a social downfall.

programme.title: Murder in Sainte Baume
programme.desc: Carel has returned to his native Provence. With his ex-schoolmate, today head of the local police, he investigates the death of a man killed by dozens of bee stings. Soon they uncover a horrific case from the past, one that had shaken the whole village.

programme.title: Sleepless Night
programme.desc: A cop with a connection to the criminal underworld finds his secret life exposed when he and his partner are caught stealing cocaine from a powerful drug dealer, a move that puts his son's life in jeopardy.

programme.title: The Hunt
programme.desc: After the death of their father and mother, four siblings reunite to come to terms with the tragedy. They decide to participate in a hunting challenge which will determine their inheritance.

programme.title: Governance
programme.desc: Renzo, a brilliant and unscrupulous manager is forced to quit his position as general manager of an oil group after an investigation for corruption. Convinced that a young colleague betrayed him, he plots his revenge, but the situation gets out of hand.

programme.title: Diana's Wedding
programme.desc: Through the eyes of Diana, we witness the rollercoaster ride of both her parent’s and Irene’s marriages. To both girls, they have the worst parents in the world. But at the end of the day, which of the couples remain strong and which fall apart ?

programme.title: Ricky
programme.desc: When Katie, an ordinary woman, meets Paco, an ordinary man, something magical and miraculous happens: a love story. From this union will be born an extraordinary baby: Ricky.

programme.title: In Other Circumstances: Death of a Stalker
programme.desc: What if everyone believed you were a killer? After a man threatening her son is found dead with her gun, Detective Jana Winter becomes the prime suspect. To clear her name, she must confront a mastermind who knows her every fear.

programme.title: Tuesday Club
programme.desc: Karin's world crumbles on her 40th anniversary when she discovers her husband’s infidelity. Seeking solace in a cooking class with renowned chef Henrik, she rediscovers her lifelong passions and learns that it is never too late to follow her dreams.

programme.title: A House In Jerusalem
programme.desc: Grappling with the loss of her mother, Rebecca and her father relocate to Jerusalem for a fresh start. In the eerie Valley of the Ghosts, strange occurrences unfold, and Rebecca embarks on a journey to unravel the mysteries within the old house and city.

programme.title: Manta Manta: Legacy
programme.desc: Ex-racer Bertie is facing financial issues with his car repair shop and go-kart track. He plans to participate in an upcoming 90’s race to solve his money problems, but he is suddenly asked by his ex-wife to take care of their son.

programme.title: Wajma, An Afghan Love Story
programme.desc: In conservative Kabul, young Wajma discovers she is pregnant out of wedlock. Her boyfriend denies paternity and her father locks her up for being a disgrace. Driven by desperation, Wajma takes extreme measures forcing everyone to re-think their actions.

programme.title: Red Code Blue
programme.desc: Latvia. Mid-90s. As the streets erupt in violence, idealistic rookie investigator Romāns Skulte is caught between ruthless mafias and crooked cops. Every choice could cost him his life—but abandoning his principles may cost him his soul.

programme.title: The Secret Life of Trees S01 - EP3
programme.desc: Whether a tree's lifespan is a hundred or a thousand years, eventually it reaches the end of its story and dies. But for trees, the end of one life can mean the beginning of another. In this episode, we discover how trees can extend their lives by 'walking' across the land and planting new roots, how they can 'learn' from trauma, and how a decaying tree has the miraculous ability to nurture new life.

programme.title: Griff's Great Kiwi Road Trip S01 - EP2
programme.desc: Griff Rhys Jones journey heads down New Zealand's back roads sees him travel from Auckland to the Coromandel, on to Taupo and finally Wellington.

programme.title: Engineering Repurposed S01 - EP6
programme.desc: Inspect an abandoned silo complex repurposed into a show-stopping art gallery, then visit a family home carved out of an ancient fortress. Witness the ways in which these abandoned structures have been reinvented as part of epic upcycling projects.

programme.title: Running Wild with Bear Grylls S04 - Joseph Gordon-Levitt
programme.desc: Actor Joseph Gordon-Levitt tackles Kenya's unyielding terrain with Bear Grylls. Dropped into the elements from a helicopter, Joseph and Bear navigate a perilous rappel, milk a camel for needed hydration, and ascend a massive rock dome that tests Joseph's fear of heights like nothing before. As the duo battles a crocodile for the remains of a water buffalo that is their only hope for dinner, Joseph details his rise to fame and his efforts to honour the memory of his beloved brother.

programme.desc: Dad agrees to take Bluey and Bingo to the shops to buy an ice-cream if they can get him into the car. Only problem is... he's just entered 'Ragdoll' mode!

programme.title: Hey Duggee S05 - The Shopping Badge
programme.desc: Duggee loves to shop local, so the Big Shop is a Big Deal for him. He's over-excited and wants two of everything. The Squirrels have to remind him 'we only popped in for milk!'

programme.title: Hey Duggee S05 - The Good Choices
programme.desc: The Squirrels haven't been making good choices round the messy clubhouse. With Duggee's help, they start to get it right. But not before sending Roly's imagination into overdrive!

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club S01 - Ready Or Not
programme.desc: Duggee looks all around, but can he find the Squirrels? Let’s play Hide and Seek!

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club S01 - Stick Together
programme.desc: Have you seen Duggee? Help the Squirrels search for him, but they need to stick together!

programme.title: Go Jetters S02 - Sami Reindeer Herding, Norway
programme.desc: The Go Jetters are in snowy Norway to learn about the Sami reindeer. The reindeers are migrating and need to get a ferry to their warmer summer home.

programme.title: Bluey S01 - Bob Bilby
programme.desc: When it's Bingo's turn to bring her Kindy's Bob Bilby puppet home and record their weekend in the scrapbook, the family resolve to show him a good time.

programme.title: Bluey S02 - Movies
programme.desc: It is Bluey's first trip to the cinema, but she's worried that the movie will be too scary. When Bingo starts running amok in the theatre, she must conquer her fear and help Dad out.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Cubby
programme.desc: Bluey and Bingo build a very special cubby for their stuffed toy Kimjim.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Exercise
programme.desc: Dad thinks he needs to do some exercise, but Bingo pretends to be Boss Bluey's new employee in the middle of Dad's backyard workout.

programme.title: Andy's Dino Island S01 - Andy and the Runaway Ankylosaurus
programme.desc: Andy and Jen discover a meteorite crater on Dino Island. But a grumpy old Ankylosaurus charges through their camp.

programme.title: Playtime Towers S01 - Frog
programme.desc: Bella and Lift have fun pretending to be frogs, and Kingsley and Queenie have a froggy fiesta. In Boxtropolis, Sketch splats a picture of a lily pad fit for a frog.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S04 - The Recipe Badge
programme.desc: The hungry Squirrels turn to Duggee when they aren't sure what to eat. Fortunately, he has his cookbook The Clubhouse Kitchen: Tasty Bites for Hungry Squirrels.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S04 - The Nature Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels can learn more about nature and wildlife if they follow five easy steps: watch carefully, stay at a distance, don't interfere, be patient and alert, and stay quiet.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S04 - The Dos and Don'ts Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels are causing a bit too much mess in the clubhouse, so Duggee explains that they need to think more carefully about what they are doing.

programme.title: Go Jetters S02 - Petra, Jordan
programme.desc: Grandmaster Glitch goes on a desert adventure to uncover a mysterious lost city. If only it hadn't already been discovered! As Glitch attempts to beat a group of tourists to Petra in Jordan, he crashes his Grimbler in the Siq gorge. Vibrations from the Grimblers engines shake the surrounding area, causing the treasury building to shake apart. Can the Go Jetters save the ancient city?

programme.title: Go Jetters S01 - The Paddy Fields of China
programme.desc: The Go Jetters swing into action when Glitch uses real landmarks for his crazy golf course.

programme.title: Thomas & Friends S24 - A New Arrival
programme.desc: When Thomas finds out that the Earl's Technology Fair will bring new inventions to Sodor, he fears the Sodor engines will be replaced by new technology.

programme.title: Stan Can S01 - Cake

programme.title: Stan Can S01 - Dinosaur

programme.desc: It is a lovely day and the squirrels are playing outside. They are playing the shape game. Working out which shape goes where is quite tricky.

programme.title: Teletubbies S01 - Swap Places
programme.desc: The Teletubbies swap places in the Tubby Car and drive to the Hidey Hup. They swap places again on the Tubby Uppy Downy before going up and down.

programme.title: Police Force
programme.desc: A man joins the Hong Kong police force to track down a murderer who has killed his friend in a robbery. While he struggles to reconcile his law defending police duty with his desire for vengeance, he also has a new-found respect for the law.

programme.title: The Female Prince
programme.desc: Hsiao's stepmother frames her fiance Lung when he refuses to forfeit their engagement and sends him to prison. To save him, Hsiao disguises as Lung to take the Imperial exam and ranks first place. Impressed by Hsiao, the Emperor weds the Princess to 'him'. When Hsiao comes clean on their wedding night, she persuades the Princess to follow a plan...

programme.title: Pursuit of a Killer
programme.desc: The charm of Pursuit Of A Killer lies in the long awaited reunion of Five Venoms duo, Lo Meng and Sun Chien; Lo Meng, who plays a Mainland Chinese criminal escapee to Hong Kong in search of a better life, and a cop (Sun Chien) who helps him adjust to Hong Kong life while tracking down his mysterious killer at the same time.

programme.title: Murder Plot
programme.desc: Martial artist Shen Lang is in discussions with kung fu experts from the other six sects to plot the downfall of the traitorous Happy King when his fiancee suddenly disrupts them and Shen has to quickly bring her away. As they continue to pursue the Happy King, both Shen and his fiancee accidentally fall into a trap set up by the King.

programme.title: The Tigress Of Shaolin
programme.desc: Sam is being hunted as he discovers that the mayor and the chief of medical bureau are colluding with a drug dealer. He is saved by a fishermen family and works in their friend's grocery but the grocery owner is killed when the enemies track Sam down. Sam escapes to Shaolin to learn the cudgel style of kung fu in order to avenge his friends.

programme.title: The Black Tavern
programme.desc: This sword-filled thriller centres on The Black Tavern – an inn where the down and dirty meet to plot nefarious doings. A bunch of villains are lured to the inn by a rumour about a valuable treasure being hidden there. After all the backstabbing and killings, they realise that it is a trap created to wipe them out once and for all...

programme.title: The Scandalous Warlord
programme.desc: General Feng occupies the city of Shandong, and soldiers and civilians alike welcome him without knowing his tyrannical and lustful nature. His first official business is to inspect the brothels and take the prostitutes home to become his concubines. Feng is finally killed by his officers, but will the new general rule the city differently?

programme.title: Swordswomen Three
programme.desc: Crouching Tiger, Hidden Dragon could be called "Swordswomen Two." Three decades earlier, Shen Yi, Essie Lin Chia, and Pan Ying-tzu took on Shaw's first international superstar, Lo Lieh for the Han Family Sword - making this a four-star treat for action fans.

programme.title: Lady General Hua Mu-Lan
programme.desc: Mulan disguises herself as a male soldier to replace her aged father in a war against the barbarians. Her courage brings her victory in battles and she was promoted to a general. When Mulan returns home with glory, the chief commander asks her to marry his daughter, forcing Mulan to reveal her true identity.

programme.title: The Imperial Tomb Raiders
programme.desc: The story revolves around a maverick, a band of woman warriors and a group of ruthless bandits. The maverick teams up with the woman warriors to battle the bandits seeking to raid the emperor's tomb.

programme.title: The Emperor and the Minister
programme.desc: The ingenious imperial scholar Liu Yung always embarrasses Emperor Chien Lung with his quick wit and gift of gab. The emperor purposely sets him up to solve the seemingly unsolvable. However, Liu Yung resolves it easily with wit and style and foils the emperor's plot once again.

programme.title: Rendezvous With Death
programme.desc: Sun Chung had been recognized as an expert comedy and crime thriller director, but he was to gain even greater acclaim for his soulful, powerful, intelligent, and beautifully-made martial arts epics. This stands alongside The Deadly Breaking Sword and The Kung-fu Instructor as one of his very best. It's not so much the plot - a master swordsman protects a treasure chest on a dangerous journey - that makes this great, but what Sun does with it, inspiring the cast and crew to some of their finest

programme.title: The Delinquent
programme.desc: This is a coming-of-age tale depicting the lower class Hong Kong troubled youths in the 1960s and the societal issues that they face. Wang Chung is a hotheaded and rebellious teen who is tempted by the dark side, and have to unfortunately pay a huge price for it.

programme.title: The Bully
programme.desc: For lovers of the Shaw's sumptuous production and martial arts expertise, this action adventure in the "Jackie Chan style" is a special treat. A persecuted waiter turns to a "drunken master" for help when a restaurant customer turns out to be a kung-fu harbinger of doom!

programme.title: Tiger Killer
programme.desc: Wu Song is appointed as chief constable after killing a tiger with his bare hands when drunk. The wife of his brother Wu Da Lang, seduces Wu Song but gets rejected by him, and engages in an affair with a rich man. They poison Wu Da Lang when he finds out about their affair. To avenge his brother's death, Wu Song kills both of them.

programme.title: Tiger Killer
programme.desc: Wu Song is appointed as chief constable after killing a tiger with his bare hands when drunk. The wife of his brother Wu Da Lang, seduces Wu Song but gets rejected by him, and engages in an affair with a rich man. They poison Wu Da Lang when he finds out about their affair. To avenge his brother's death, Wu Song kills both of them.

programme.title: The Lady Professional
programme.desc: Lily Ho is perfectly cast as a gun-for-hire who always gets her man - in more ways than one! The cast and crew shot on location in Japanese scenic spots such as Mount Fuji; and there are plenty of over-the-top thrills, as Lily even masquerades as a nun.

programme.title: The Story of Sue San
programme.desc: TIn this Huangmei Opera romance, Wang is the son of a respected government official whereas Sue San is a famous prostitute. Although they love each other and seem to be perfectly matched, the two are worlds apart when it comes to social ranking, which will prove hard to overcome...

programme.title: Two Con Men
programme.desc: Two Con Men is a wonderfully twisted, pseudo-romantic comedy in the vein of "Robin Hood" meets "The Sting". Starring Liang Tien as Clever Chan and Chang Ying (who's done over 400 films) as Tricky Ching, it's the age-old competition between a rookie con artist versus the ultimate, experienced flimflam man. It's a game Chen cannot afford to lose, because people's lives - including his own, hang in the balance of good versus evil.

programme.title: Pursuit of Vengeance
programme.desc: Fu Hong Xue, a legendary swordsman, travels far to avenge his father, only to find the seven killers he tracks are already dead. Investigating with Yeh Kai, he learns they are alive, manipulated by disguise master Xiao Bie Li, who lures Fu into a trap. Yeh Kai aids him, but both end up trapped in a deadly blade formation.

programme.title: The Warlord
programme.desc: A bandit became a warlord in northern China by helping Russia fight against Japan. Due to his ignorance and silly behaviour, he is seen as a joke to everyone. The warlord is finally killed by the daughter of a troupe master whom he had killed for no reason, bringing a befitting end to a traitor.

programme.title: The Fighting Fool
programme.desc: Famous Kung Fu Pole master Red Eagle, is kidnapped by a villain one day. His disciple Meng, vows to rescue him. On his way, Meng encounters a greedy but great martial artist who agrees to join him in the rescue. Even though the two have extremely different personalities, they manage to team up and fight the villain in a final showdown.

programme.title: The Comedy of Mismatches
programme.desc: Two pairs of lovers got mismatched accidentally. The man disguises as a woman for his sister's wedding ceremony, while his lover disguises as a man to marry another woman. After the marriage mismatches are revealed, the lovers and their families are taken to court, where Prefecture Chief Qiao manages to work out a happy ending.

programme.title: Executioners From Shaolin
programme.desc: The White-Browed Priest supports the brutal Qing government, burning down Shaolin Temple and hunting its disciples. Shaolin's Hung falls in love with Fang while escaping the hunt and the couple have a son before Hung is killed by the Priest. To avenge his father, Hung's son creates a new form of martial art combining his parents' kung fu styles.

programme.title: The Empress Dowager
programme.desc: Award-winning drama featuring a passionate performance by Lisa Lu, enhanced by sumptuous costumes and sets, produces a powerful, fascinating story. In five thousand years of Chinese history, there was never a more fascinating woman than the dragon lady of the Ching Dynasty, also the Empress Dowager, who was the power behind the throne for the last half of the 19th century. The vast tapestry of palace intrigues is vividly brought to the screen.

programme.title: The Condemned
programme.desc: Feng, a homeless man, is wrongly accused of robbery and subsequently arrested and imprisoned. The actual bandit bribes fellow inmate Yang, a pickpocket, to kill Feng. Aware of Feng's innocence, Yang resolves to help him escape from prison. However, their escape attempt goes awry, and both find themselves facing the grim reality of death row.

programme.title: Fangs of the Cobra
programme.desc: Incredibly, the title serpent is not a harbinger of horror, but actually the film's hero. This virtuous viper sniffs out bombs, fights gangs, battles a baby-killing rodent and even takes on a duplicitous woman. This one-of-a-kind thriller will be applauded by reptile fans everywhere.

programme.title: Mad Monkey Kung Fu
programme.desc: Master Chen was an esteemed Monkey Kung Fu master, until he is framed and crippled by a ruthless villain and ends up becoming a wandering artiste. When Chen meets a young man, Little Monkey, on the streets, he decides to teach him all his monkey kung fu moves. Both men eventually team up to avenge Chen's past insult.

programme.title: The Tiger and the Widow
programme.desc: The Liu Chia-liang trained Hui Ying-hung was considered the top action martial arts female star in the 1980s. It is her martial arts abilities that Michelle Yeoh tries to emulate. In The Tiger and the Widow, Hui Ying-hung is somehow mixed up in a salt smuggling ring that stinks of missing persons and rotten dilemmas.

programme.title: Portrait In Crystal
programme.desc: Tragic deaths in the underworld cause leader "Yama" (Teng Wei-hao) to suspect a portrait in crystal with mysterious powers. He sends Hen Pan (Chen Hung) and Pai Pan (Hung Hsin-nan) to interrogate its creator, martial artist Lung Fei (Pai Piao)...

programme.title: A Maid From Heaven
programme.desc: The seventh daughter of the Jade Emperor is banished from heaven to live a mortal life as she is very mischievous. She falls in love with a young village lad Yong, who sold himself to work for the rich so as to bury his father. The goddess sisters help Yong to pay his debt so the lovebirds can be together. Is this going to end happily-ever-after?

programme.title: A Maid From Heaven
programme.desc: The seventh daughter of the Jade Emperor is banished from heaven to live a mortal life as she is very mischievous. She falls in love with a young village lad Yong, who sold himself to work for the rich so as to bury his father. The goddess sisters help Yong to pay his debt so the lovebirds can be together. Is this going to end happily-ever-after?

programme.title: The Singing Killer
programme.desc: Chiang Yi is blackmailed into a jewellery heist by his former boss who threatens to expose his shady past. Complications arise when Chiang Yi discovers his first love working in the jewellery store.

programme.title: Forbidden Tales of Two Cities
programme.desc: Li Han-hsiang wrote and directed this charming and fascinating comedy, Forbidden Tales Of Two Cities. The two cities in the picture are Macau, where a love quartet is a morally-unsound source for sexual entertainment; and Hong Kong, where a woman enters a gambler's apartment to find four shackles hanging from his ceiling to aid in kinky activities.

programme.title: Martial Club
programme.desc: The young Wong Fei Hung and his friend Wang Yin Lin offend the young master of another rival school and the expert they hire, causing both martial arts schools to fight against each other. This is Director Liu Chia Liang's masterpiece and one of the top ten highest grossing movies in 1981.

programme.title: Gambler's Delight
programme.desc: The Killer star Danny Lee plays the lead role of a guy who needs to become a hero. He lies, steals and cheats his way into operating a plush casino, but when he incurs the wrath of a female Japanese gang leader, all bets are off!

programme.title: Sunset
programme.desc: Teenage heart-throbs Ching Li and Paul Chin Pei come across like Annette Funicello and Frankie Avalon in the musical Sunset, a musical romp that plays similar to one of Hollywood's famous "Beach Party" movies. A car load of girls meets a car load of boys, and Ching and Paul ultimately fall in love. Yet the film takes an acrid twist and turns out to be more like a Shakespearian tragedy than a beach-babe party.

programme.title: The Shaolin Avengers
programme.desc: Hu seeks to avenge his father who is being killed by the White-Browed Hermit and his gang. However, he fails in his attempt and is saved by Fang Shi Yu, a youth from Shaolin whose parents are also killed by the same villains. They learn and master the advanced Shaolin style kung fu, before Fang leads Hu and the Shaolin fellows to fight the enemies.

programme.title: My Name Ain't Suzie
programme.desc: Young Mei Li works as a bar girl in Wanchai to make a living. When she meets Jimmy in the bar, she thinks he is her true love and falls crazily in love with him. When Jimmy has to leave, Mei Li is devastated. It is not until she encounters the triad boss Ying that she finally found someone to count on.

programme.title: The Flying Dagger
programme.desc: The Yu family and the Green Dragon clan became enemies when the Yu daughter killed the clan head's son, who was a rapist and murderer. The Green Dragon leader wounds the head of the Yu family with his flying daggers, and a wandering swordsman saves the family using his own flying dagger skills. However, his allegiances and motives are unclear.

programme.title: Enchanting Shadow
programme.desc: A young scholar Ning spends the night in a creepy temple that is said to be haunted. He does not believe in the rumours, but soon meets a beautiful female ghost Nie. Nie is forced to stay in the temple to seduce young men for a powerful demon to feast on. Knowing Nie to be a kind ghost, Ning decides to help her escape from the demon's clutches.

programme.title: The Singing Thief
programme.desc: A master jewel thief turns over a new leaf as a professional singer in a nightclub. However, a series of robberies happened shortly after and he becomes the suspect again. The thief then sets up a trap to snare the copycat but will this backfire on him?

programme.title: The Blue and the Black
programme.desc: Set during the Japanese occupation in World War II, a young orphan Tang Qi falls in a love with a young man Chang. However, their love is filled with challenges, from family pressure to the turmoil of war. When Tang Qi was raped, she is expelled from home to become a nightclub singer and embarks on a journey of no return...

programme.title: Wits Of The Brats
programme.desc: Nan Tou Kuan, a spoiled but talented young heir from Guangdong, is sent to Beijing by his mother to find a bride and mature. Along the way, he befriends three rogues: a cardsharp, a ladies' man, and a master thief. Together, they must outwit the sinister Three-Eyed Taoist, who plots to seize the family's fortune.

programme.title: Facets Of Love
programme.desc: Set in the Ming Dynasty, the story revolves around a brothel and the girls who work there. The film begins by following the life of a girl from a poor family, who is sold by her mother to the brothel. While she is the most beautiful of the girls and attracts many clients, the girl hopes to escape this sad way of life one day.

programme.title: Legend Of The Fist- The Return Of Chen Zhen
programme.desc: In 1920s Shanghai, Chen Zhen goes undercover as a businessman to expose a mob boss's collaboration with the Japanese. While gaining his trust, he must also combat a wave of assassins sent by a brutal Japanese general. Fighting from the shadows in a black mask, he allies with a police captain to protect the city's patriots with his formidable fists.

programme.title: Let's Have a Baby
programme.desc: De Sheng and Wan Jun have been married for years, but are unable to conceive. Wan Jun decides to undergo artificial insemination in the States and finally gets pregnant. She meets her cousin from the States who stays temporarily in their house with them, and De Sheng begins to suspect that they are having an affair…

programme.title: The Grandmaster
programme.desc: Directed by the acclaimed filmmaker Wong Kar Wai, this epic action feature begins in Foshan when Ip Man, the martial arts master from the south, takes up a challenge by ageing northern master Gong Yu Tian. Ip Man wins the fight, but is then defeated by Gong Yu Tian’s daughter Gong Er, with whom he forms an emotional bond…

programme.title: Turns We Take
programme.desc: A spicy hot pot restaurant in Northeast China serves different types of customers every day. Amongst them are a sweet young couple, two wayward young men and a taxi driver. Despite being complete strangers to each other, their lives are intertwined by a traffic accident…

programme.title: The Fate of Reunion
programme.desc: Thousands of years ago, Green Snake gained enlightenment under the guidance of Dao Qing and gradually falls for him. However, her devotion to Dao Qing caused him to reincarnate and go through the pains of death. Since then, she sets out to search for the many reincarnations of Dao Qing over hundreds of years to help him reverse the situation…

programme.title: The Revenge
programme.desc: Ruo Wei returns to her childhood home with two best friends, and reunites with her cousin who has always lived there. While they plan to enjoy their trip, they are constantly haunted by paranormal events, ending up in a terrifying experience with unexpected outcome.

programme.title: The Gangster, the Cop, the Devil
programme.desc: Detective Lin forms a special task force to crack down on violent motorbike robbers terrorising Foshan and expose the syndicate behind them. However, when his pregnant wife becomes a victim during a brutal attack, Lin uncovers a ruthless conspiracy driven by revenge, pushing him into a dangerous battle against criminals with nothing to lose.

programme.title: Lifeline
programme.desc: A heroic tale about Hong Kong's brave firefighters. These courageous men can march into disastrous firegrounds and risk their lives to save others. However, do they have the same courage to confront their personal issues?

programme.title: Flying Swords of Dragon Gate
programme.desc: This is a remake of the original 1966 classic, Dragon Gate Inn. The country is being policed by the East and West Bureaus, whilst the Emperor’s eunuchs have attained much power and control. With all the corruption, Zhao teams up with a group of assassins to systemically kill the eunuchs in order to save the country.

programme.title: Perfect Girls
programme.desc: Chi will inherit his dying grandfather’s fortune with one condition – he has to be married in a month, otherwise the money goes to his uncle, Robert. Chi falls in love with Siu Siu, but Robert intends to stop them by sending Moraine to seduce Chi. When Moraine decides to marry Chi for money, Robert stops her and reveals their plot.

programme.title: The Grey Men
programme.desc: Hong Kong police officer Ah Shan goes undercover in prison to gain the trust of criminal Tian and seek evidence against his gang. After their release, Shan helps Tian rise within the gang and become the new boss. However, as Shan cracks down on the gang, he uncovers a shocking secret about Tian...

programme.title: Hong Kong Hong Kong
programme.desc: After moving to Hong Kong, illegal immigrant Mang has no choice but to live in cramped quarters with male migrants who abuse her. In order to attain Hong Kong residency and a better life, she agrees to marry a lonely old carpenter. After her marriage, Mang crosses paths again with her ex-lover, and the two develop a passionate affair...

programme.title: Casino Tycoon II
programme.desc: This is a sequel to “Casino Tycoon”. 20 years after Benny Ho established his casino empire in Macau, his former partner becomes envious and plots to bring him down. At the same time, a young man working for Benny is the son of his ex-lover, and is also out to take revenge on him. Ho however, is not about to take things lying down…

programme.title: When Fortune Smiles
programme.desc: A rich man dies, leaving all his fortune to his daughter in his will, but his son and nephew want a piece of the pie. The nephew sends Vincent to steal the will and the son finds Fung, who looks like his sister, to get the will. Vincent plans to marry Fung for the fortune, but as the two fall in love, they decide to unveil the cunning schemes.

programme.title: Unmatchable Match
programme.desc: Undercover cop Lang is assigned to befriend former triad boss Fei in order to investigate a diamond heist masterminded by the ruthless gangster Big Mad. When the deal goes awry and the diamonds end up in Fei’s possession, Big Mad comes after them with a vengeance, forcing Lang and Fei to join forces as an unlikely bond begins to form between them.

programme.title: Unmatchable Match
programme.desc: Undercover cop Lang is assigned to befriend former triad boss Fei in order to investigate a diamond heist masterminded by the ruthless gangster Big Mad. When the deal goes awry and the diamonds end up in Fei’s possession, Big Mad comes after them with a vengeance, forcing Lang and Fei to join forces as an unlikely bond begins to form between them.

programme.title: The Case of Disappearances
programme.desc: In Misty Village, the adopted son Wen Jie is haunted by a recurring nightmare. He delves into a series of disappearance cases in the village to seek his true identity. As more villagers die mysteriously, belief in the curse of Emperor Jing Lung intensifies. Wen Jie teams up with the security chief to unveil the conspiracy and protect the villagers.

programme.title: The Illegal Immigrant
programme.desc: This is a gritty and realistic Chinatown tale about the life of a Chinese illegal immigrant and his journey in New York. He is looking for a fake marriage with a girl so as to gain the right of abode there. Despite all the hardships and misfortunes, he tries to cope with life and reach for his dreams.

programme.title: Wusong VS Ximenqing
programme.desc: After uncovering his sister-in-law Pan Jin Lian’s affair with the corrupt Xi Men Qing, Wu Song is falsely accused and exiled. However, when his elder brother is murdered, Wu Song returns determined to seek justice. With the authorities refusing to punish the guilty, his fury drives him toward a bloody path of revenge.

programme.title: Night Watch
programme.desc: After a car accident erases his memory, Wang Ren Jie takes a job as a night guard. When the clock strikes midnight, he reports for duty at an abandoned building — only to find three lost souls awaiting him, and unravels a revenge plot at the same time. Is this fate or a curse cast by vengeful spirits?

programme.title: Ip Man
programme.desc: Wing Chun grandmaster Ip Man’s matchless fighting skills are revered all over China. Set during the Sino-Japanese War, Ip Man is forced to leave his home and work to support his family. With only his martial arts skills, he reluctantly agrees to train others in the art of Wing Chun for self-defense.

programme.title: Confession of Pain
programme.desc: When the billionaire father-in-law of veteran homicide detective Hei is brutally murdered, Hei's wife, doubting the police investigation, hires his former partner and close friend, private detective Bong, to uncover the truth. As the case takes unexpected twists, Bong discovers the murder is mysteriously linked to Hei.

programme.title: Royal Tramp
programme.desc: Wei Xiao Bao is sent by a revolutionary group to be a spy in the imperial palace and find “The Sutra of 42 Chapters”. Xiao Bao soon befriends Emperor Kang Xi but must carry out his mission at the same time, so he is caught between two camps.

programme.title: Cruel War
programme.desc: To combat the greenhouse effect, scientist Yan Xin attempts to plant newly developed super rubber seeds on a remote island, hoping to transform it into a thriving new land. Yan Xin's ex-husband decides to accompany her on this perilous journey. As conflicts arise, they encounter the local drug cartel, and a fatal battle is about to begin.

programme.title: Let's Make Laugh II
programme.desc: Bodyguard Ah Sun is sent to protect his boss' son, only to meet and fall in love with his mistress, the gorgeous Joey. As love blossoms between the two, the powerful boss finds out and all hell breaks loose!

programme.title: King Of Beggars
programme.desc: So was born a nobleman but is relegated to a beggar after being caught cheating. He becomes the chief of the Beggar’s gang when he saves the gang’s elder. One day, So foils an assassination attempt on the Emperor and is allowed to reinstate his status but he declines. He is then rewarded with an imperial beggar bowl and lives happily ever after.

programme.title: 36 Secrets of Courtship
programme.desc: This erotic comedy features three lotharios who vie to become principal of the Macho Man Training School -- an extremely sexy institution dedicated to extremely non Shaolin-types of physical exertion.

programme.title: Iron Kung Fu Fist
programme.desc: Martial arts master Liang Kun withdraws from the jianghu to protect the woman he loves, but his absence leads to her tragic death. Realising he can no longer escape his fate, he returns to the martial world. With the help of beggar clan leader Su Can, Liang Kun fights his way through ruthless enemies to avenge her.

programme.title: Mr Vampire II
programme.desc: Grave-robbing archaeologists unearth a family of preserved vampires and plan to sell them on the black market. However, they accidentally break the paper spells that had kept the vampires immobilized during transport. The vampires escape, but a local herbalist Lin is soon on their trail, determined to destroy them.

programme.title: Final Justice (1988)
programme.desc: Chang is a brilliant police inspector, but his maverick ways have put him at odds with both his superiors and peers. When he encounters Wai, a streetwise car thief who accidentally becomes the key to tracking down a gang of armed bank robbers, the two form an uneasy alliance to bring the criminals to justice.

programme.title: Sex Beyond The Grave
programme.desc: During World War II, a singer was raped and killed by Master Tao during her escape, with all her valuables stolen as well. Since then, the Tao’s house became haunted. Years later, Master Tao’s descendant sells the house to a young couple to pay off a massive gambling debt, but the couple soon discover that it is haunted by the vengeful spirit...

programme.title: Young Ip Man: Crisis Time
programme.desc: Set in 1917, young Ip Man pursues his studies in Hong Kong. The school is held hostage on the day of an English speech competition, and as Ip Man decides to step up and fight the crisis, it is revealed that his master and his childhood friend are behind all this. Can he take them down and uphold justice?

programme.title: Young Ip Man: Crisis Time
programme.desc: Set in 1917, young Ip Man pursues his studies in Hong Kong. The school is held hostage on the day of an English speech competition, and as Ip Man decides to step up and fight the crisis, it is revealed that his master and his childhood friend are behind all this. Can he take them down and uphold justice?

programme.title: Seeding Of A Ghost
programme.desc: It's an erotic gore-fest starring Kao Fei who seeks vengeance against his wife's rapists and killers by soliciting the help of a demented magician. In return, he endures copulating dead bodies as his enemies perish in blood spurting and body exploding glory. It's one of Hong Kong goriest films ever made.

programme.title: Infernal Affairs III
programme.desc: Ming is transferred to do menial police work ten months after the murder of Yan, in 2004. Meanwhile, a new star, Wing, has emerged in the police force and Ming suspects he is also a mole sent by the triad. Determined to start anew, Ming must kill Wing while ensuring his own identity does not get exposed.

programme.title: Bangkok Storm
programme.desc: Underground boxer Lin Feng is hunted by the Bangkok triad when he refuses to fight in an illegal match. He escaped successfully but lost his memory. While Feng begins a new life, the triad finds him and hires a top boxer to beat him. As Feng suddenly regains his memory in the process, he vows to take down the triad.

programme.title: Detrimental
programme.desc: You Ji Ren is a blind man who works at a factory on an outlying island. When the factory is cut off from the outside world by a hurricane one day, a monster appears and turns whoever sees it into black shadows. As You cannot see the monster, he is able to help his other co-workers escape safely and fight to kill the monster.

programme.title: Royal Tramp II
programme.desc: The leader of Dragon clan, Long Er, helps General Wu to overthrow Emperor Kang Xi. However, Long Er is betrayed by General Wu and is rescued by Xiao Bao. As a result, she bestows her virginity and martial arts power to Xiao Bao to fight against Wu. At the same time, Xiao Bao fortuitously unveils the hidden treasures from “The Sutra of 42 Chapters”.

programme.title: The Mask of Shura of Fire Cloud
programme.desc: 18 years ago, the evil Black Feather clan infiltrated the territory of Master Fire Cloud and stole The Mask of Shura, thus releasing an evil spirit that was a baby. Master Fire Cloud adopted the baby to prevent him from becoming evil. When the baby grows up, he takes control of the mask and becomes Fire Cloud’s successor as the city’s guard.

programme.title: The Sorcerer & The White Snake
programme.desc: In this action fantasy movie based on the Chinese legend of the White Snake, a young herbalist falls in love with a thousand-year-old white snake disguised as a woman. When the white snake's true identity is revealed, a sorcerer goes to battle believing that in doing so, he is restoring balance and order between man and the supernatural.

programme.title: The Last Tycoon
programme.desc: Gangster Chen Da Qi rises to the upper echelons of power, but finds himself torn between the love of two women, the murderous plots of the secret service, and the looming threat of war.

programme.title: Lost Memories
programme.desc: As a young mother grapples with her daughter's mysterious disappearance, a series of eerie events unfold. These events could be linked to the vengeful ghosts of a tragic accident that happened 20 years ago...

programme.title: The Grey Men 2
programme.desc: Triad boss Song seeks to whitewash his image and seize Laika’s mayoral seat amid a regime change. He faces a funding shortfall despite colluding with officials, and gets his right-hand man and enforcer to commit crimes to boost his funds and power. Just as Song believes success is imminent, the dynamics between the three take an unexpected turn…

programme.title: From Beijing With Love
programme.desc: A reactivated backup Chinese agent, posing as a butcher, is unexpectedly assigned to recover a stolen dinosaur skull. Sent to Hong Kong, he is aided by a female agent who is secretly working for the villains. Together, they navigate betrayals and confront the mastermind, ultimately recovering the national treasure and exposing the conspiracy.

programme.title: Initial D
programme.desc: The movie is adapted from a famous Japanese manga. 18-year-old Takumi delivers tofu in his father's near-obsolete car every day and becomes a good racer with perfect drifting skill. Encouraged by his father, he joins a mountain race and unexpectedly wins it, making him famous overnight and leading him from one exciting race to another.

programme.title: Chinese Odyssey1-Pandora's box
programme.desc: Joker, a carefree bandit leader, learns he is the reincarnation of the Monkey King. As demons and immortals close in, he is drawn into a chaotic, time-bending journey with the mystical Pandora’s Box. Caught between past and present, he must choose between destiny and freedom.

programme.title: Cop Shop Babes
programme.desc: Island East Police Station headed by Madam Lui is known for its “Cop Shop Babes” as all the officers there are female. Two police officers, Beer and Satay, apply for an internal transfer to this station in order to approach the girls. It is at this time that the police receives a bomb threat – can they resolve the case?

programme.title: Fast & Furious: Spy Racers S2 - The Rescue
programme.desc: Tony’s been kidnapped..by Sudarikov! The rest of the team must break into the plane where Tony’s being held and rescue him – all while 30,000 feet in the air!

programme.title: Fast & Furious: Spy Racers S2 - Anchors Away
programme.desc: The team manages to rescue Tony, but not before Sudarikov sends their plane crashing into the ocean. Now they’re trapped underwater and must defend themselves against falling torpedoes, AI enemy submarines, and their most dangerous foe yet: the sea! Cisco takes command of the hauler-turned-sub, waging a daring underwater battle.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Paws Of Destiny S1 - Enter the Dragon Master
programme.desc: After absorbing the mystical Hero Chi of the Four Constellations, four panda kids enlist the Dragon Master to teach them Kung Fu

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Paws Of Destiny S1 - Blue Dragon Plays with Fire
programme.desc: When the kids grow over-confident after beginning their training, they decide to intercept a distress call and sneak off without permission, only to land themselves in hot water

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Paws Of Destiny S1 - Blade of the Red Phoenix
programme.desc: Po and the kids are recruited to perform in Mei Mei's theatrical show, but things take a turn when Jindiao ruins the play in order to find a mystical scroll

programme.title: DRAGONS 9 REALMS S1 - First Flight: Part 1
programme.desc: Moving to an exotic new home, an adventurous teenager meets a new group of kids and discovers a dragon in the fissure.

programme.title: DRAGONS 9 REALMS S1 - First Flight: Part 2
programme.desc: Tom forges a friendship with the dragon and discovers an entire world of dragons within the fissure.

programme.title: Dinotrux S2 - Sawmetrodon
programme.desc: Ty, Revvit and the crew save a band of Woodland Reptools from an evil and destructive Sawmetradon named Splitter who refuses to join the Trux team.

programme.title: Dinotrux S2 - Speed
programme.desc: Ty can't stop rolling after Skrap-It steals his master cylinder, so the Trux must quickly figure out a fix before he falls off the edge of a cliff

programme.title: The Adventures Of Puss In Boots S1 - Hidden
programme.desc: Puss stumbles upon the legendary hidden city of San Lorenzo, and soon finds himself forced to protect it from thieves.

programme.title: The Adventures Of Puss In Boots S1 - Sphinx
programme.desc: Puss accidentally gives the orphans a magic substance that will ultimately make them explode. The only cure is guarded by a Sphinx who challenges Puss with riddles - and contrary to his own belief, Puss is not good at riddles.

programme.title: Fifi and the Flowertots S2 - Compost Chaos
programme.desc: Primrose can't make her garden grow and turns to Fifi for advice. She is amazed when Fifi points out that you need to water and weed a garden. And surely she can't really mean putting that yucky compost everywhere can she?

programme.title: Fifi and the Flowertots S2 - Bumble's Afraid Of The Dark
programme.desc: Primrose and Violet are having a sleepover. When Bumble admits that he is scared of the dark, the tots try everything to stop him from being afraid

programme.title: Fifi and the Flowertots S2 - Count On Fifi
programme.desc: Fifi and Bumble deliver lots of delicious honey to Poppy's stall. They lose a pot on the way and there isn't enough to go round. Can they find the missing pot, or will Stingo have to go without his honey for tea?

programme.title: Fifi and the Flowertots S2 - Poppy The Line Dancing Queen
programme.desc: Poppy is having a line dancing party, but none of the other flowertots know how to do it. Will any of them learn to dance in time or will Poppy have to cancel the party?

programme.title: Fifi and the Flowertots S2 - King Stingo
programme.desc: Aunt Tulip has lost Grubby again. When Stingo finds him, he asks to be made King as a reward. It isn't long before he has gone too far and the tots are all fed up with his demands. Can Fifi get life in the garden back to normal?

programme.title: Fifi and the Flowertots S2 - Hide And Seek
programme.desc: The tots are playing hide and seek and the winner will get Fifi's delicious jam tarts. Who will win, Stingo and Slugsy are sure it will be them!

programme.title: Team Zenko Go S1 - Rodney J. Dinkle, Babysitter Lights Out
programme.desc: When accident-prone Rodney gets hired to babysit a mischievous toddler, TZG secretly watches over their safety. When there’s a power outage in Harmony Harbor, TZG secretly helps the townsfolk beat the blackout.

programme.title: Team Zenko Go S1 - Double Booked Gym Enemy Cricket
programme.desc: When both Sam and Gabriel pre-order the new Commander Kale comic but the supplier only sends one copy, TZG secretly ferries the comic book back and forth between readers. When Fawna teaches a silent yoga class, TZG secretly find and remove a loud chirping cricket from the Community Center.

programme.title: Olivia S1 - Olivia Takes A Road Trip
programme.desc: On the looooong drive to Grandma's house, Olivia finds ways to pass the time. She imagines her family traveling in style, as she pilots her very own jumbo jet–Olivia Air! By the time they arrive at Grandma's, Olivia's had so much fun that the discomfort of the road trip has been forgotten.

programme.title: Olivia S1 - Olivia Goes International
programme.desc: When asked to give a presentation for her class's International Day. Olivia can't decide which country to choose. Being Olivia she invents her own country –Olivitania -where cupcakes are the national food and the national anthem sounds suspiciously like Puccini.

programme.title: Olivia S1 - Olivia And Her Alien Brother
programme.desc: After a trip to the planetarium, Ian's knowledge about space and his peculiar behaviour lead Olivia to believe that her brother is an alien. Olivia soon discovers his secret…he's making a special gift for his favourite sister

programme.title: Olivia S1 - Olivia Plants A Garden
programme.desc: When Mrs. Hogenmuller distributes seeds for a class garden project, Olivia just can't wait for her plants to grow. But when her dog Perry digs up her little garden, Olivia discovers something even more exciting – what appears to be a dinosaur bone!

programme.title: Casper's Scare School S2 - Cappy's Mail Order Eyes Pumpkin Pal
programme.desc: Cappy’s Mail Order Eyes ‐ Casper and his friends order some new eyes for Cappy’s birthday present. Cappy’s delighted until he pops them in and finds the world is TRULY horrifying. Cappy is so terrified he runs away to Deedstown. The little monsters suddenly realise that they’ve ordered Sea Monkey eyes by mistake! Casper has to get Cappy AND the eyes back before Cappy loses his marbles completely. Pumpkin Pal – Poor old Pumkinhead. Thatch has been teasing him for having an ‘imaginary friend’. Cas

programme.title: Casper's Scare School S2 - The Day The Professor Croaked A Potent Brew
programme.desc: The Day the Professor Croaked – Professor Burns wants a day off. Casper tries to help by pretending that Mosshead’s pet toad IS the professor, temporarily changed in form. But today is a big inspection day – Kibosh is on his way to grade the teachers and that toad’s going to have to teach class or else! A Potent Brew ‐ Casper’s uncle Stinky gets sucked into one of Jimmy’s dad Graham’s crazy monster catching gadgets – a tea pot – ALONGWITH Graham himself. And they can’t get out. The more they pan

programme.title: Dew Drops Diaries S1 - Mailed Away The Wandering Wand
programme.desc: When Harper unknowingly drops her cooking camp application on the way to post office, it’s up to the Dew Drops to get it into that big blue mailbox. When Cassie accidentally places Lola's beloved, old toy wand in a box marked for a giveaway drive in the park, the Dew Drops must find a way to retrieve the wand before it ends up in the hands of an entirely new family.

programme.title: Dew Drops Diaries S1 - Lucky Penny Hammy’s Day Out
programme.desc: Marcus has a piano recital and unknowingly forgets his lucky penny at home. Now it’s up to the Dew Drops to get the penny across town and back into Marcus’ pocket before showtime. When Nicholas rolls the hamster ball (with Hammy inside) out into the streets, the Dew Drops must get Hammy back home safely.

programme.title: Not Quite Narwhal S1 - Mom’s Birthday Angry
programme.desc: Kelp and Scallop enlist Cruz’s help to perform a dance for Mom’s birthday. Though it’s hard at first, they learn to put their dolphin, unicorn, and narwhal powers together to create something special. Kelp, Pixie, Ollie, and their friend Leroy try to help Juniper understand her angry feelings.

programme.title: Not Quite Narwhal S1 - Tuskist Three Moon Festival
programme.desc: Scallop is afraid of her first “tuskist” appointment. Kelp helps her get through it with a song. Fog rolls in, threatening Kelp’s first Three Moon Festival in Unicorn Land. Kelp and his friends use a combination of unicorn spark and the Kelp Way to create a new festival.

programme.title: Go, Dog. Go! S1 - Ding Dong Day \ Grand Sam
programme.desc: It’s Pawston’s annual Take Your Kid to Work Day, and it’s Tag’s year to spend the day at the Doorbell Store with Paw. \ Sam Whippet challenges the Not Yet Cadets to complete an obstacle course in the woods.

programme.title: Go, Dog. Go! S1 - Clucky Day \ Take Me Out to the Fetch Game
programme.desc: Scooch is bummed out because he’s missing his favorite holiday back in his old farm town, so Tag wants to cheer him up by rounding up some chickens and bringing Clucky Day to Pawston. \ When there’s a schedule mix-up and the Pawston Get Sox players think they have a day off, it’s up to Tag and Scooch to round up all five players in time for the fetch game, so that they don’t have to forfeit.

programme.title: Dragons: Rescue Riders S1 - Boo to You
programme.desc: Burple gets spooked by the legend of a ghost called the Phantom Fang. But when he senses the story is real, he can't get his friends to believe him.

programme.title: Dragons: Rescue Riders S1 - Where There's Smoke
programme.desc: After Magnus accuses Cutter of setting fires near the village that could hurt the sheep, the Riders have to put them out and find the real culprit.

programme.title: Madagascar: A Little Wild S1 - Fire Marshal Melman
programme.desc: On Junior Marshals’ Day at the fire station, Melman gets stuck in a firetruck on its way to a real emergency. With Alex’s help, Melman must overcome his fear of heights to help save a stuck cat, and learn that even heroes get scared sometimes.

programme.title: Madagascar: A Little Wild S1 - Fancy Fifths
programme.desc: When Marty accidentally “steals” a pair of slippers from a department store, he plans an elaborate “heist” to return them and learns in the end that it’s easier to own up to your mistakes than to cover them up.

programme.title: Trolls: The Beat Goes On! S1 - Royal Review Funishment
programme.desc: Poppy faces her first royal review as Queen and sets out to ensure 100 happiness in Troll VillagePoppy must figure out how to handle crime in Troll Village when Cooper steals a pie.

programme.title: Trolls: The Beat Goes On! S1 - Bad News Bergens Unhealthy Competition
programme.desc: Poppy signs the Trolls up for a game of Bergenball with the toughest Bergen team aroundSmidge and Guy Diamond face off in a competition for juice dominance.

programme.title: Dragons: Riders of Berk S1 - Animal House
programme.desc: As an approaching storm threatens Berk, Hiccup must work fast to make peace between the food-providing farm animals and the dragons.

programme.title: Dragons: Riders of Berk S1 - The Terrible Twos
programme.desc: When Hiccup adopts a baby dragon that appears orphaned, Toothless becomes jealous and the baby dragon’s bereaved mother threatens the village.

programme.title: Spirit Riding Free: Pony Tales S3 - The Healing Tree
programme.desc: While riding back to Miradero, the girls get lost -- and Abigail's horse gets bitten by a snake! Can an old friend's skills help save the day?

programme.title: Spirit Riding Free: Pony Tales S3 - The Mystery of the Golden Unicorn
programme.desc: After finding a majestic horse in the wild, Lucky and the girls set out to solve the mystery of where she came from -- and where she truly belongs.

programme.title: Home: Adventures With Tip And Oh! S2 - Citizen Brain Lair Liar Pods On Fire
programme.desc: The Big Brain Boov recruit Oh to join them; Oh is introduced to the concept of "harmless lying," and lies so much that he is unable to distinguish between fact and fiction

programme.title: Home: Adventures With Tip And Oh! S2 - Chercophonie Oh, Man, And The Sea
programme.desc: Tip becomes a Boovsland rock icon due to her awful guitar playing; When Donny takes Oh fishing, they battle a giant Sturgeon

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Dragon Knight S1 - The Lost City
